description: A Director of Operations must decide whether Casey should remain the sponsor of a cross-department process-improvement initiative after complaints that Casey's feedback style damaged trust. The binding decision must set the sponsorship status, evidence record, contact safeguards, coaching plan, and review process.

shared_context.S1: Casey sponsors a process-improvement initiative involving operations, customer support, and product teams.
shared_context.S2: Several participants have reported that feedback during the initiative has made collaboration tense.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to retain or remove Casey as sponsor and to impose a repair plan.
shared_context.S4: Elena's standard governance checklist includes a stakeholder review of observed repair efforts, contact boundaries, active commitments, and applicable workplace-relations procedures before a sponsor decision.
shared_context.S5: The initiative's governance file records stakeholder observations, agreed contact boundaries, active commitments, and applicable workplace-relations requirements.
shared_context.S6: At the decision meeting, Elena records the outcome and any resulting action commitments in the initiative governance file.
shared_context.S7: Before Elena closes each checklist item, the person responsible for relevant information must make a formal recorded disclosure of that information; informal discussion does not close the item.

PF1.text: Casey told the project coordinator this week that Casey will accept a coaching plan lasting exactly 45 days and will attend every scheduled session; this willingness has not yet been put in writing for Elena.

PF2.text: Malik personally observed exactly three occasions in which Casey repaired harm by apologizing, correcting a public misunderstanding, and inviting the affected teammate to revise the next agenda; Malik has not entered these examples in formal feedback.

PF3.text: Riley needs all contact with Casey about the initiative to be facilitated rather than unmoderated one-to-one contact for exactly the next 30 days, followed by a separate preparation meeting before any joint discussion; Riley has not raised this boundary directly with Elena.

PF4.text: Tessa confirmed from the current workplace-relations procedure that a retained sponsor in a substantiated interpersonal concern requires an independent HR check exactly on day 30 and a written no-retaliation notice; the procedure update has not been added to the initiative packet.

acceptance_conditions: Casey must remain the initiative sponsor.
The record must contain exactly three observed repair examples.
All initiative contact between Casey and Riley must be facilitated for exactly 30 days, followed by a separate preparation meeting before any joint discussion.
Casey must undertake the agreed 45-day coaching plan.
An independent HR check must occur exactly on day 30.
A written no-retaliation notice must be issued.
The settlement must include commitments to carry out the coaching plan, Riley's facilitated-contact and preparation process, and the independent HR check.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'coaching_plan' and c['target'] == 'Casey' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Riley' and (c['type'] == 'contact_boundary' or c['type'] == 'facilitated_contact') for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Casey's stated willingness changes the coaching-plan duration to exactly 45 days and supports a coaching-plan commitment targeting Casey.
Malik's firsthand observations change the record to exactly three repair examples and provide the specific basis for retaining Casey as sponsor.
Riley's boundary changes the contact decision to exactly 30 facilitated days with a required preparation meeting and requires a contact-boundary commitment targeting Riley.
The confirmed procedure changes the repair plan by requiring an independent HR check exactly on day 30 and a written no-retaliation notice.
